remarks: Located in highly desirable North Monrovia's historic district, this charming single-story residence beautifully blends timeless character. Featuring 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, the home showcases original built-ins, rich architectural details, and high ceilings that create a warm and inviting atmosphere. French doors in the living room add classic elegance and welcome natural light. Enjoy the comfort of central air conditioning and heating, updated plumbing and electrical, and a newer roof, hardwood floors. A charming breakfast nook in the kitchen provides the perfect spot to start your day. The inviting front porch offers a wonderful place to relax and take in the beautiful mountain views
